title: Shazam launches its first ever sticker pack to celebrate Ariana Grande's new album - 9to5Mac
summary: The Apple-owned Shazam app today announced its first ever Artist Sticker Pack, available for free as part of the latest update to the Shazam app. The sticker pack is celebrating the global release of Ariana Grande’s new album petal .
